questions.stem: This Prussian blue-stained peripheral blood smear (arrows) shows blue granular inclusions clustered at the periphery of red blood cells. These inclusions are aggregates of which substance?

explanation.summary: The arrows indicate Pappenheimer bodies, iron-containing granules that stain with Prussian blue and cluster at the RBC periphery. They reflect abnormal iron incorporation seen in sideroblastic anemia, not hemoglobin, nuclear, or RNA remnants.
